city: Seiko Bay, fictional port jurisdiction within Tokyo Bay
rules: A digital signature establishes that an authorized delegate acted, not necessarily that the human consented to this particular action.
No mind uploading, magic AGI or supernatural explanation.
Each technological consequence requires a documented real-world precursor and an explicit speculative link.
No literal visual or narrative borrowing from Ghost in the Shell; mood influence only.
Human characters retain memory and consequences of their actions across installments.
